policy.summary: Public methods on the listed surfaces must be fully annotated. Any is allowed only at explicitly documented compatibility or payload-extension boundaries.
policy.new_public_method_rule: A new method on a listed public surface is scanned automatically and must not introduce missing annotations or Any unless a matching any_allowlist entry with owner, reason, and narrowing plan is added in the same change.

any_allowlist.reason: RecordStore writes preserve application-defined record payloads and metadata without constraining their serializable domain shape.
any_allowlist.narrowing_plan: Replace metadata dictionaries with named record projection types while retaining a generic serializable content parameter.

any_allowlist.reason: The explicit synchronous record signature mirrors async_record_data, including application-defined content and RecordStore metadata.
any_allowlist.narrowing_plan: Follow the async record projection types when that payload extension boundary is narrowed.

any_allowlist.reason: Released AgentTask compatibility returns task metadata, or an awaitable of it inside an event loop. Keep this loop-dependent legacy escape hatch until its announced 4.2 cleanup; get_meta/async_get_meta have the precise execution metadata contract.
any_allowlist.narrowing_plan: Remove the announced legacy adapter or supply the strategy-owned typed projection during the 4.2 compatibility cleanup; do not broaden the unified execution APIs.

any_allowlist.reason: Released task metadata includes strategy-owned nested iteration/verification records with open payloads. It is distinct from the typed unified async_get_meta contract.
any_allowlist.narrowing_plan: Remove the announced legacy adapter or supply the strategy-owned typed projection during the 4.2 compatibility cleanup; do not broaden the unified execution APIs.

any_allowlist.reason: Released task creation forwards an open strategy-specific keyword projection. It does not define a closed task options schema.
any_allowlist.narrowing_plan: Remove the announced legacy adapter or supply the strategy-owned typed projection during the 4.2 compatibility cleanup; do not broaden the unified execution APIs.
